sources.snippet: UnimeType Transliteration 4B is a focused language conversion model for everyday, mixed-language writing. It converts Pinyin, Romaji, Romanized Hindi, Hinglish, and Arabizi while keeping clear English words, product names, links, code, numbers, punctuation, and emoji in place.
